findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#cg250-in" for opacity between 522.96s and 523.04s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: A GSAP set on "#cg250-in" for opacity fires at 523.04s while a tween on it is still running (522.96s to 523.08s).
findings.fixHint: Let the tween finish before the set fires: move the set to 523.08s or later, or shorten the tween. Played in order the set wins; seeked (scrub, export) the tween can win, so an old state stays visible.
findings.snippet: tl.fromTo("#cg250-in", { opacity: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: "power2.out" }, 522.96) tl.set("#cg250-in", { opacity: 0, visibility: "hidden" }, 523.04)

findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "proxy (unresolved DOM association)" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 23.04s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.
findings.snippet: tl.fromTo("proxy (unresolved DOM association)", { v: 0.59, duration: 0.9, ease: "power2.out" }, 23.04) tl.fromTo("proxy (unresolved DOM association)", { v: 0.77, duration: 0.9, ease: "power2.out" }, 28.28)
